items.title: Commencement
notes: A special meeting of City Council was held at 5:18 p.m. this date, chaired by Mayor B. Vrbanovic. Notice of this meeting had been previously given to all members of Council by the City Clerk pursuant to Chapter 25 (Council Procedure) of the Municipal Code.

items.title: Disclosure of Pecuniary Interest and the General Nature Thereof
Waive Notice of Motion
notes:
It was requested to waive notice to add an additional urgent matter related to legal advice on procurement process - solicitor client privilege authorized by to Section 239 (2) (f) of the Municipal Act, 2001, to the in-camera meeting later this date.

To approve the additional item 2/3 of the Whole of Council is required.

items.title: Legal Advice on Procurement Process - Solicitor Client Privilege
Adjournment
notes: On motion the meeting adjourned at 5:20 p.m.

motions.text: "That an in-camera meeting of City Council be held immediately following the special council meeting this date to consider 2 matters relating to land acquisition and disposition as authorized by Sections 239 (a) and (c) of the Municipal Act, 2001, respectively."

motions.text: “That pursuant to Section 25.4.4 (f) of Chapter 25 (Council Procedure) of the Municipal Code, the requirement for Notice of Motion be waived to add an urgent matter to the Special Council agenda to receive legal advice on procurement process - solicitor client privilege authorized by to Section 239 (2) (f) of the Municipal Act, 2001."
